reason: Below-threshold exponents need many failures at small p. At toric L=5 and p=.10 the Release run has 1 failure in 10,000 trials, so the source 25-failure rule excludes that point. The N=8, L=11 wing was not run.
cost_estimate: About 54 CPU-hours per toric L=11, N=8 point, and the low-p code-capacity points produce too few failures to fit a slope.
decision: No suppression slope was fit. The N=8 L=11 points were not started.
justification: A slope fit is not identified when the 25-failure rule removes the below-threshold points. More trials at those points would still be a different design from the missing source grid.
